name: Naturalisation via Marriage to an Icelandic Citizen

qualifying_event.description: Marriage to an Icelandic citizen does not grant citizenship automatically. It reduces the standard 7-year naturalisation residence requirement to 4 years, provided the Icelandic spouse has held citizenship for at least 5 years.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; proof of 4 years' residence; spouse's proof of holding Icelandic citizenship for 5+ years.

requirements.blocker_text: Must be married to an Icelandic citizen who has held Icelandic citizenship for at least 5 years. Gender-neutral.
4 years of legal domicile and continuous residence in Iceland while married to the Icelandic citizen (reduced from the standard 7-year bar).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 4 years of continuous residence while married.

requirements.blocker_text: Must hold permanent residence in Iceland at the time of application and decision (see is_permanent_residence.json's spouse-of-citizen 3-year reduced track).

evidence_required.document: Spouse's proof of 5+ years holding Icelandic citizenship

sources.title: Island.is -- Application for Icelandic Citizenship: When Can I Apply: 4-year reduced residence for spouses of Icelandic citizens who have held citizenship 5+ years

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Iceland). Gender-neutral. Notably, the requirement is not just 'married for X years' but specifically 4 years of RESIDENCE while married, and the Icelandic spouse must independently have held citizenship for 5+ years (preventing two recently-naturalised people from fast-tracking each other). A separate, slower 5-year cohabiting-partner (non-married) track also exists -- see is_naturalisation.json's cohabiting_partner group.
